message.content: EmilyBurnett highlights the significant consequences of Cersei's choices throughout the series. She emphasizes how Cersei's relentless pursuit of power and her actions, particularly those taken after losing her children, led to her becoming a ruthless and power-hungry figure. EmilyBurnett points out that Cersei's choices had a profound impact on her relationships and legacy, stating that "losing her kids really pushed her over the edge, didn't it?" This loss is described as pushing Cersei into embracing cruelty to secure her power. EmilyBurnett also notes the tragic irony of Cersei achieving her goals but losing so much in the process, suggesting that she may have regretted these choices even as she appeared confident. She believes that Cersei's character arc reflects the idea that power comes at a high personal cost.
